headline: Richie's call is today. Second straight day at 87 initials with both accounts running.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Richie's call is today and it is the only new cash August can still produce. Get the proof in front of him before it, then log the outcome the same day rather than leaving it open the way the last four were left. Those four are still blank: Robert, luca, Evan and Joshua Haber, and the month closes Monday. Six replies also sit untagged: Alexander Cano, Jack trades, Leppan, Alexandra flame, Nick sanders and Matthew Chamberlin.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Monday's reply count. Two days at 87 initials land their replies Monday and Tuesday on the measured four day lag, and that is the first real evidence on whether account 2 carries its share.
